notes: Quicklook aperture flux, not a calibrated or aperture-corrected source spectrum.
Native pixels and conservative flags are used; background is estimated in a local annulus. No resampled display pixels are measured.
Wavelength uses the approximate per-pixel WCS-WAVE mapping, not the precision CWAVE calibration.
Error bars include native variance and annulus background uncertainty; calibration and confusion systematics are omitted.
Observations are taken at different times. Variability can shape this wavelength plot.
Markers are catalog predictions, not detections in SPHEREx pixels.
Gaia proper motions are applied where available; parallax displacement is not modeled.
AllWISE stationary-solution coordinates are not propagated; fast movers may be offset.
